note: Recorded 2026-08-18 (updated same day: 76 -> 1 after root-causing every family). `mismatch_counts` are a CEILING: growth means words that used to agree with the oracle no longer do. New families FAIL outright.

known_open.instruction_length: EXACTLY ONE, adjudicated: `0f 1e /r` without F3. The SDM documents 0F 19-0F 1F as reserved hint-NOPs that EXECUTE AS NOP on real processors; our decoder accepts them as NOP (3 bytes here), LLVM prints `<unknown>` and stops after 2. This is the two-decoders-disagree case the harness doc warns about, and the HARDWARE sides with our reading — changing the decoder to match LLVM would model LLVM, not the ISA. Ceiling 1; a second word in this family means something else regressed.
